name: rulekit
description: Guardrails for both halves of the agent loop: rulekit keeps conventions in view at the moment of an edit, exhalekit forces the design review after the commit.

plugins.name: rulekit
plugins.description: Just-in-time coding conventions for Claude Code: path/content-matched rules that block or nudge at the moment of an edit, with pluggable detectors, per-session escape hatches, and read-side guardrails. Ships a Rails preset, including an optional commented Sorbet inline-RBS advisory that hands off to a bundled skill.

plugins.name: exhalekit
plugins.description: The exhale half of the inhale/exhale rhythm. A PostToolUse hook nudges for a simplicity and duplication review after every non-refactor commit, /exhale-init installs a diff-scoped rubycritic runner so that review has evidence behind it, and /simplify-with-analysis runs the deeper regression pass on demand.
